intent: Size one Recharts chart to its box and give every series in it a color custom property from a ChartConfig.
typical_uses: A bar, line, area or pie chart of a few series
A chart whose tooltip and legend read series labels and colors from one config

dont_use_when.situation: The reader needs exact values to compare or copy
One value measured against a range or a goal

invariants.text: Every ChartConfig key becomes a `--color-<key>` custom property scoped to this container's `data-chart` id, so a series paints with `fill="var(--color-<key>)"` or `stroke="var(--color-<key>)"`. A key with neither `color` nor `theme` takes `--chart-1` to `--chart-5` by its own position in the config, wrapping after the fifth; an explicit value wins without shifting the others.

`id` is not rendered as the div's `id` attribute: the div carries `data-chart="chart-<id>"`, or `chart-` and a generated id when `id` is not given, reduced to letters, digits, `_` and `-`. A `data-chart` passed by the caller is replaced by it.

Every config key is reduced to letters, digits, `_` and `-` before it reaches the stylesheet, and a color containing `;`, a brace, an angle bracket, a backslash or a comment marker is dropped whole: its `--color-<key>` declaration is left out, so a flat color leaves the property undefined, and a rejected dark value of a `theme` pair falls back to its light value.

The chart mounts only while the container has a positive width and height; until the first measurement it assumes `initialDimension` (320 by 200 when not given). chart.module.css gives the container a 16 / 9 aspect ratio, which a consumer class can override.
ChartTooltipContent and ChartLegendContent read the same ChartConfig through context to resolve each series' label and icon.

anti_patterns.dont: Hard-code a series color on the chart element and leave the key out of the config
anti_patterns.do_instead: Put the color in the ChartConfig entry and paint with `var(--color-<key>)`; the tooltip and legend read each series' label from the same entry
Use a `--chart-*` step or a brand color; the muted foreground is the color of the chart's own axis text, so a series in it blends into the chart's furniture

children.states: children is the Recharts chart element the container sizes
children.because: `ReactNode` - an element tree, which no JSON Schema type covers.

config.states: config maps each series key to an optional label, icon component and a flat color or a light and dark color pair
config.because: `ChartConfig` is a record of objects whose `icon` is a React component and whose `color` and `theme` exclude each other, which the compiler emits no JSON type for.

initialDimension.states: initialDimension is the width and height in pixels the chart assumes before its first measurement
initialDimension.because: `{ width: number; height: number }` - an object type the compiler emits no JSON type for.

unexposed_parts.reason: Composed inside ChartContainer from the library; only `initialDimension` is exposed, as ChartContainer's own prop.

good.title: A bar chart with a tooltip and a legend
good.code:
const chartConfig = {
  desktop: { label: 'Desktop', color: 'var(--chart-1)' },
  mobile: { label: 'Mobile', color: 'var(--chart-2)' },
} satisfies ChartConfig;

<ChartContainer config={chartConfig}>
  <BarChart data={data}>
    <XAxis dataKey="month" />
    <Bar dataKey="desktop" fill="var(--color-desktop)" />
    <Bar dataKey="mobile" fill="var(--color-mobile)" />
    <ChartTooltip content={<ChartTooltipContent />} />
    <ChartLegend content={<ChartLegendContent />} />
  </BarChart>
</ChartContainer>

good.title: A fixed-height chart
good.code:
<ChartContainer config={chartConfig} className={styles.chart} id="revenue">
  <LineChart data={data}>
    <Line dataKey="desktop" stroke="var(--color-desktop)" />
  </LineChart>
</ChartContainer>

bad.title: A series color that bypasses the config
bad.why: The legend resolves each series' label from the config, so a key missing from it renders a swatch with no label.

companions.typed_by: Record<string, { label?: ReactNode; icon?: ComponentType } & ({ color?: string; theme?: never } | { color?: never; theme: Record<"light" | "dark", string> })>
companions.description: The type of `config`, shared by ChartContainer and ChartStyle; declare a config with `satisfies ChartConfig`.

cannot_extract: default: prop "initialDimension" defaults to "INITIAL_DIMENSION", which is not a literal - the body gives no single literal default for it
